scientific_integrity: All numbers computed from complete GF2 polynomial coefficients with exact algebraic smoothness criteria; both independent implementations and their outputs supplied. Counts are not based on sampling or prior tables.
scientific_limitations: Statement is an exact weighted finite-field joint enumeration for F2 only; bitangent means even intersection divisor including hyperflex. The earlier full classification of characteristic-two plane quartics is not new; independent priority and code audits have not been performed.
title: The joint rational-point and bitangent spectrum of smooth plane quartics over \(\mathbf F_2\)
